name: Recombinant bacterial plasmid cloning
summary: A Genentech-led team inserted synthetic human insulin genes into bacterial plasmids so E. coli made insulin chains, showing bacteria could produce human proteins.
description: Recombinant bacterial plasmid cloning of a foreign DNA sequence for propagation or expression in E. coli.

why: Insulin for diabetics came from animal pancreases; a firm saw commercial value in making the human protein in bacteria.
